articles.title: Building the spine first
articles.dek: Why we built the backbone before the surface — and what that buys us.
articles.excerpt: The backbone is yours, which is the only kind worth building. A field note on sequencing the work.

body.text: 1. Start with what everything else hangs on

body.html:
This is sanitised rich text with bold, italic, a link, and a list:

  • First the data model.
  • Then the renderer.
  • Then the surface.

body.caption: The dependency direction: surface depends on spine, never the reverse.

body.html: The temptation is always to start where it shows.

body.text: The backbone is yours, which is the only kind worth building.
